title: Duplicate Conditional Fragments
pattern: Placing identical statements/side effects in every branch of a conditional expression.
why_bad: It leads to code bloat and increases modification risk. If the arguments or the invocation logic for `send()` change, it must be edited inside every branch.
detection: The same expression/statement is executed as the first or last action within all distinct branches of an `if-else` block.
source: *Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code* (1st Edition), "Consolidate Duplicate Conditional Fragments", p. 241, 286.
